title.sk: Sviečková na smotane s kysnutou knedľou
title.en: Svíčková: beef in creamy root vegetable sauce with bread dumplings

description.sk: Dusené hovädzie v krémovej omáčke z koreňovej zeleniny, s domácou knedľou a brusnicami.
description.en: Braised beef in a creamy root vegetable sauce, with homemade bread dumplings and cranberries.

note.en: 1½ tsp for the sauce, 1 for the dumplings

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 160 °C. Mäso osuš, odkroj z neho blany a šľachy a natri ho 1,5 lyžičkou soli a korením. Mrkvu, petržlen a zeler ošúp a nakrájaj na kúsky veľké ako orech, cibuľu na mesiačiky a slaninu na drobné kocky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 160 °C. Pat the beef dry, trim off membranes and sinew and rub it with 1½ teaspoons of salt and the pepper. Peel the carrots, parsley root and celeriac and cut them into walnut-sized pieces; cut the onion into wedges and dice the bacon finely.

steps.sk: V hrnci vhodnom do rúry rozpusti maslo so slaninou a mäso na ňom opeč na strednom ohni zo všetkých strán dohneda. Vyber ho, pridaj zeleninu a opekaj 10 minút, kým nezačne zlatnúť – opečená zelenina dá omáčke farbu aj sladkosť.
steps.en: Melt the butter with the bacon in an ovenproof pot and brown the beef on all sides over a medium heat. Lift it out, add the vegetables and fry for 10 minutes until they start to colour; browned vegetables give the sauce its colour and sweetness.

steps.sk: Mäso vráť na zeleninu, pridaj bobkové listy, nové korenie, ocot, cukor a 500 ml vody, prikry a nechaj dusiť v rúre 2 až 2,5 hodiny. Po hodine mäso otoč a podľa potreby dolej vodu; hotové je, keď doň vidlička vojde bez odporu.
steps.en: Return the beef to the vegetables, add the bay leaves, allspice, vinegar, sugar and 500 ml water, cover and braise in the oven for 2 to 2½ hours. Turn the meat after an hour and top up with water if needed; it is done when a fork slides in without resistance.

steps.sk: Kým sa mäso dusí, priprav knedľu: rožky nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1 cm a nechaj ich preschnúť. Do vlažného mlieka vmiešaj droždie a štipku cukru a nechaj 10 minút speniť, potom ho s vajcom, múkou a lyžičkou soli vymies na hladké, tuhšie cesto.
steps.en: While the beef braises, make the dumplings: cut the rolls into 1 cm cubes and leave them to dry out. Stir the yeast and a pinch of sugar into lukewarm milk and leave it to foam for 10 minutes, then knead it with the egg, flour and a teaspoon of salt into a smooth, fairly firm dough.

steps.sk: Do cesta zapracuj kocky rožkov, prikry ho a nechaj 45 minút kysnúť. Potom ho rozdeľ na dva valčeky dlhé asi 20 cm, polož ich na pomúčenú dosku a nechaj podkysnúť ešte 15 minút, kým trochu nezväčšia objem.
steps.en: Work the bread cubes into the dough, cover it and leave it to rise for 45 minutes. Then divide it into two logs about 20 cm long, lay them on a floured board and let them prove for another 15 minutes until slightly puffed.

steps.sk: Valčeky var vo veľkom hrnci mierne vriacej vody 20 minút, v polovici ich otoč. Hneď po vybratí ich na viacerých miestach prepichni vidličkou, aby unikla para – inak sa zrazia a stvrdnú.
steps.en: Simmer the logs in a large pot of gently boiling water for 20 minutes, turning them halfway. As soon as you lift them out, prick them in several places with a fork to let the steam escape; otherwise they collapse and turn hard.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber a zakry alobalom. Bobkové listy a nové korenie vylov, zeleninu so šťavou rozmixuj dohladka a vmiešaj smotanu, horčicu a citrónovú šťavu. Omáčku prihrej 5 minút a dochuť soľou a cukrom tak, aby bola jemne sladkokyslá.
steps.en: Lift out the beef and cover it with foil. Fish out the bay leaves and allspice, blend the vegetables with the juices until smooth and stir in the cream, mustard and lemon juice. Warm the sauce for 5 minutes and season with salt and sugar until gently sweet and sour.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj naprieč vláknami na plátky hrubé 1 cm a knedľu ostrým nožom alebo niťou na plátky. Podávaj s hustou omáčkou a lyžicou brusníc. Mäso v omáčke vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a dá sa aj zamraziť.
steps.en: Slice the beef across the grain 1 cm thick and cut the dumplings into slices with a sharp knife or a thread. Serve with plenty of sauce and a spoonful of cranberries. The beef in its sauce keeps in the fridge for 3 days and also freezes well.

title.sk: Bravčové pliecko na rasci s dusenou kapustou
title.en: Caraway roast pork shoulder with braised cabbage

description.sk: Chrumkavé pečené bravčové so sladkokyslou kapustou a varenými zemiakmi.
description.en: Crisp-topped roast pork with sweet and sour cabbage and boiled potatoes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Mäso osuš a tukovú stranu narež do mriežky hlbokej 5 mm. Cesnak roztlač s lyžičkou soli na pastu, vmiešaj 1,5 lyžičky rasce a korenie a mäso ňou natri zo všetkých strán aj do zárezov.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Pat the pork dry and score the fat side in a 5 mm deep criss-cross. Crush the garlic with a teaspoon of salt to a paste, mix in 1½ teaspoons of caraway and the pepper and rub it all over the meat and into the cuts.

steps.sk: Jednu cibuľu nakrájaj na hrubé kolieska a rozlož ich na dno pekáča. Mäso na ne polož tukovou stranou nahor, podlej 200 ml vody, prikry alobalom a peč 1 hodinu.
steps.en: Slice one onion into thick rings and spread them over the base of a roasting dish. Set the pork on top fat side up, pour in 200 ml water, cover with foil and roast for 1 hour.

steps.sk: Odkry ho, polej výpekom, zvýš teplotu na 200 °C a peč ďalších 45 až 60 minút, kým povrch nie je chrumkavý. Vždy, keď sa výpek odparí, dolej trochu vody. Hotové je pri 70 °C vnútri, keď z neho po prepichnutí vyteká číra šťava.
steps.en: Uncover, baste with the juices, raise the oven to 200 °C and roast for another 45 to 60 minutes until the top is crisp. Add a splash of water whenever the juices dry up. It is done at 70 °C inside, when the juices run clear when pierced.

steps.sk: Medzitým nakrájaj kapustu bez hrubého koreňa na tenké rezance a druhú cibuľu nadrobno. Cibuľu speň na masti, pridaj kapustu, zvyšnú rascu, ½ lyžičky soli, 100 ml vody, ocot a cukor, prikry a nechaj dusiť 30 minút do mäkka.
steps.en: Meanwhile, shred the cabbage finely, discarding the tough core, and chop the second onion. Soften the onion in the lard, add the cabbage, the rest of the caraway, ½ teaspoon of salt, 100 ml water, the vinegar and sugar, cover and braise for 30 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, prekroj a var v osolenej vode (½ lyžičky soli) 20 minút do mäkka. Kapustu popráš múkou, premiešaj a povar 3 minúty, kým šťava nezhustne; dochuť ju, aby bola výrazne sladkokyslá.
steps.en: Peel and halve the potatoes and boil them in salted water (½ teaspoon of salt) for 20 minutes until tender. Dust the cabbage with the flour, stir and simmer for 3 minutes until the juices thicken; season it to a bold sweet and sour.

steps.sk: Mäso nechaj 10 minút odpočinúť, nakrájaj ho na plátky a podávaj so zemiakmi, kapustou a výpekom, ktorý v pekáči rozvaríš s trochou vody. V krabičkách vydrží všetko 3 dni a kapusta je na druhý deň ešte lepšia.
steps.en: Rest the pork for 10 minutes, slice it and serve with the potatoes, cabbage and the pan juices loosened with a little water. Everything keeps in boxes for 3 days, and the cabbage tastes even better the next day.

title.sk: Kuracie rizoto s hráškom a syrom
title.en: Chicken and pea rice with grated cheese

description.sk: Jednoduchá ryža s kuracím mäsom, mrkvou a hráškom, ako ju poznáš z jedálne – len lepšia.
description.en: Simple rice with chicken, carrot and peas, like the school canteen classic, only better.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, cibuľu nadrobno a mrkvu na malé kocky. Ryžu prepláchni v sitku studenou vodou, kým voda nie je takmer číra – rizoto potom nebude lepkavé.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into 2 cm cubes, chop the onion finely and dice the carrots small. Rinse the rice in a sieve under cold water until it runs almost clear, so the dish does not turn sticky.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu na ňom speň 3 minúty. Pridaj mäso a mrkvu, posyp mletou paprikou a soľou a opekaj 5 minút, kým mäso nezbelie zo všetkých strán. Papriku nespáľ, zhorkla by.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan over a medium heat and soften the onion for 3 minutes. Add the chicken and carrot, sprinkle with the paprika and salt and fry for 5 minutes until the meat is white all over. Do not let the paprika burn, or it turns bitter.

steps.sk: Vsyp ryžu a minútu ju miešaj, aby sa obalila tukom. Zalej ju 600 ml horúcej vody, rozdrob bujón, priveď do varu, prikry a na najmenšom ohni var 15 minút. Pokrievku počas varu nedvíhaj, unikla by para.
steps.en: Add the rice and stir for a minute to coat it in the fat. Pour in 600 ml hot water, crumble in the stock cube, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes. Do not lift the lid while it cooks, or the steam escapes.

steps.sk: Pridaj hrášok, rýchlo premiešaj, znova prikry a nechaj 5 minút dôjsť mimo ohňa. Ryža má byť mäkká a voda vstrebaná; mäso je hotové, keď je na reze biele, bez ružovej šťavy (74 °C).
steps.en: Add the peas, stir quickly, cover again and leave off the heat for 5 minutes. The rice should be tender and the water absorbed; the chicken is done when it is white in the middle with no pink juices (74 °C).

steps.sk: Rizoto okoreň, vmiešaj petržlenovú vňať a podávaj posypané strúhaným syrom, s uhorkovým šalátom alebo kyslou uhorkou. Do krabičiek ho dávaj bez syra; vydrží 3 dni a zohreješ ho s lyžicou vody.
steps.en: Season with pepper, stir in the parsley and serve topped with grated cheese, with a cucumber salad or a pickle. Pack it into boxes without the cheese; it keeps for 3 days and reheats with a spoonful of water.

title.en: Slovak meat patties with mashed potatoes

description.sk: Šťavnaté mäsové placky s majoránom a cesnakom, maslová kaša a kyslá uhorka.
description.en: Juicy meat patties with marjoram and garlic, buttery mash and a pickle.

steps.sk: Rožok nakrájaj na kocky a namoč ho v 100 ml mlieka. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a cesnak prelisuj. Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na rovnaké kusy a vlož ich do hrnca so studenou vodou a ½ lyžičkou soli.
steps.en: Cube the roll and soak it in 100 ml of the milk. Chop the onion finely and crush the garlic. Peel the potatoes, cut them into even pieces and put them in a pan of cold water with ½ teaspoon of salt.

steps.sk: Mäso daj do misy, pridaj vyžmýkaný rožok, vajce, cibuľu, cesnak, majorán, lyžičku soli a korenie a rukou ho miešaj 2 minúty, kým zmes nie je súdržná. Mokrými rukami z nej vytvaruj 8 plochých fašírok hrubých 1,5 cm a obaľ ich v strúhanke.
steps.en: Put the meat in a bowl with the squeezed-out roll, egg, onion, garlic, marjoram, a teaspoon of salt and the pepper and mix by hand for 2 minutes until it holds together. With wet hands, shape 8 flat patties 1.5 cm thick and coat them in breadcrumbs.

steps.sk: Zemiaky priveď do varu a var ich 20 minút, kým sa do nich ľahko nezapichne nôž. Medzitým začni vyprážať fašírky, aby bolo všetko hotové naraz.
steps.en: Bring the potatoes to the boil and cook them for 20 minutes until a knife slides in easily. Start frying the patties in the meantime so everything is ready together.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej na strednom ohni a fašírky na ňom vyprážaj 5 až 6 minút z každej strany do zlatohneda. Hotové sú, keď majú vnútri 70 °C a pri stlačení z nich vyteká číra šťava; na prudkom ohni by zvonka zhoreli a vnútri zostali surové.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat and fry the patties for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until golden brown. They are done at 70 °C inside, when pressing them releases clear juices; on a fierce heat they burn outside and stay raw within.

steps.sk: Zemiaky sceď, pridaj maslo a 150 ml horúceho mlieka a roztlač ich na hladkú kašu. Nemixuj ich mixérom, zlepili by sa ako guma. Dochuť štipkou soli.
steps.en: Drain the potatoes, add the butter and 150 ml hot milk and mash them until smooth. Do not use a blender, which turns them gluey. Season with a pinch of salt.

steps.sk: Fašírky podávaj s kašou, kyslou uhorkou a horčicou. Vychladnuté vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a výborne chutia aj studené v chlebe.
steps.en: Serve the patties with the mash, a pickle and mustard. Once cooled they keep in the fridge for 3 days and are just as good cold in a sandwich.

description.sk: Hustý paprikový guláš zo zemiakov a údenej klobásy, ktorý na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
description.en: A thick paprika stew of potatoes and smoked sausage that tastes even better the next day.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, klobásu na polkolieska a papriku na kocky. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, aby sa uvarili rovnomerne.
steps.en: Chop the onions finely, cut the sausage into half-moons and dice the pepper. Peel the potatoes and cut them into 2 cm cubes so they cook evenly.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti masť a cibuľu na nej smaž na miernom ohni 8 minút, kým nie je zlatistá – jej sladkosť je základ chuti guláša. Pridaj klobásu a opekaj 3 minúty, aby pustila tuk.
steps.en: Melt the lard in a pot and fry the onions over a low heat for 8 minutes until golden; their sweetness is the backbone of the goulash. Add the sausage and fry for 3 minutes to render its fat.

steps.sk: Stiahni hrniec z ohňa, vmiešaj mletú papriku, rascu a paradajkový pretlak a hneď prilej 1,2 litra vody, lebo paprika na horúcom tuku za pár sekúnd zhorkne. Pridaj zemiaky, nakrájanú papriku, bobkové listy a soľ.
steps.en: Take the pot off the heat, stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste and immediately pour in 1.2 litres of water, as paprika turns bitter in hot fat within seconds. Add the potatoes, diced pepper, bay leaves and salt.

steps.sk: Var prikryté na miernom ohni 25 minút, kým zemiaky nezmäknú a niektoré sa nezačnú rozpadávať – tie guláš prirodzene zahustia. Občas premiešaj až po dno, aby sa neprichytil.
steps.en: Simmer, covered, over a low heat for 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft and some start to break up; they thicken the goulash naturally. Stir right to the bottom now and then so it does not catch.

steps.sk: Múku rozmiešaj v 100 ml studenej vody dohladka, vlej ju do guláša a za miešania povar 5 minút. Pridaj prelisovaný cesnak a majorán, okoreň a podľa potreby dosoľ.
steps.en: Whisk the flour into 100 ml cold water until smooth, stir it into the goulash and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring. Add the crushed garlic and marjoram, season with pepper and add salt if needed.

steps.sk: Podávaj s chlebom a kyslou uhorkou. Guláš vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; pri ohrievaní prilej trochu vody, lebo zemiaky ho ďalej zahusťujú.
steps.en: Serve with bread and a pickle. The goulash keeps in the fridge for 3 days; add a little water when reheating, as the potatoes keep thickening it.

title.en: Lecsó: pepper and tomato stew with sausage and egg

description.sk: Letné dusené papriky s paradajkami, cibuľou a klobásou, zjednotené vajíčkom.
description.en: Summery stewed peppers with tomatoes, onion and sausage, finished with egg.

steps.sk: Papriky zbav jadrovníkov a nakrájaj na prúžky široké 1 cm, cibuľu na tenké polkolieska. Paradajky spar na 30 sekúnd vriacou vodou, ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky. Klobásu nakrájaj na kolieska.
steps.en: Core the peppers and cut them into 1 cm strips; slice the onions thinly. Scald the tomatoes in boiling water for 30 seconds, peel and dice them. Slice the sausage into rounds.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozohrej olej, pridaj klobásu a opekaj 3 minúty, kým nepustí tuk. Pridaj cibuľu a smaž ju 5 minút do sklovita.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan, add the sausage and fry for 3 minutes to render its fat. Add the onions and cook for 5 minutes until translucent.

steps.sk: Pridaj papriky, soľ a mletú papriku, premiešaj, prikry a nechaj dusiť 10 minút, kým papriky nezmäknú. Potom pridaj paradajky a var bez pokrievky ďalších 8 minút, aby sa šťava trochu odparila.
steps.en: Add the peppers, salt and paprika, stir, cover and stew for 10 minutes until the peppers soften. Then add the tomatoes and cook uncovered for another 8 minutes to reduce the juices a little.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj s korením, vlej ich do leča a na miernom ohni ich za stáleho miešania nechaj 2 minúty zrážať. Odstav, kým sú ešte krémové – v horúcej zelenine dôjdu.
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the pepper, pour them into the stew and stir over a low heat for 2 minutes as they set. Take it off while they are still creamy; they finish cooking in the hot vegetables.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď s čerstvým chlebom. Bez vajec sa lečo oplatí uvariť do zásoby: v chladničke vydrží 4 dni a vajcia vmiešaš až pri ohrievaní.
steps.en: Serve straight away with fresh bread. Without the eggs, lecsó is worth making in bulk: it keeps in the fridge for 4 days, and you stir in the eggs when reheating.

title.sk: Vyprážaný syr so zemiakmi a tatárskou omáčkou
title.en: Fried breaded cheese with potatoes and tartare sauce

description.sk: Chrumkavý obal, roztečený syr vnútri a domáca tatárska omáčka s uhorkami.
description.en: A crisp coating, molten cheese inside and homemade tartare sauce with pickles.

note.en: for frying; only part is absorbed

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, prekroj a vlož do hrnca so studenou vodou a ¾ lyžičky soli. Priveď ich do varu a var 20 minút do mäkka.
steps.en: Peel and halve the potatoes and put them in a pan of cold water with ¾ teaspoon of salt. Bring to the boil and cook for 20 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: Medzitým priprav tatársku omáčku: uhorky nakrájaj na drobné kocky a zmiešaj s majonézou, jogurtom, horčicou, citrónovou šťavou a nasekanou pažítkou. Daj ju vychladiť do chladničky.
steps.en: Meanwhile, make the tartare sauce: dice the pickles finely and mix them with the mayonnaise, yogurt, mustard, lemon juice and chopped chives. Chill it in the fridge.

steps.sk: Syr nakrájaj na plátky hrubé 1 až 1,5 cm – tenší by sa pri vyprážaní roztiekol. Priprav tri taniere: múku, vajcia rozšľahané so štipkou soli a strúhanku. Každý plátok obaľ v múke, vajci a strúhanke a potom ešte raz vo vajci a strúhanke.
steps.en: Cut the cheese into slices 1 to 1.5 cm thick; thinner ones melt away in the pan. Set out three plates: flour, eggs beaten with a pinch of salt, and breadcrumbs. Coat each slice in flour, egg and crumbs, then once more in egg and crumbs.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej na 170 °C – kúsok strúhanky v ňom má hneď zasyčať. Syr vyprážaj po dvoch kusoch 1 až 2 minúty z každej strany do zlatohneda. Dlhšie ho v oleji nenechávaj: keď sa obal nafúkne, syr začne vytekať.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan to 170 °C; a crumb dropped in should sizzle at once. Fry the cheese two pieces at a time for 1 to 2 minutes on each side until golden brown. Do not leave it longer: once the coating puffs up, the cheese starts to leak.

steps.sk: Hotový syr polož na papierovú utierku a podávaj hneď so zemiakmi a tatárskou omáčkou. Vychladnutý stráca chrumkavosť, preto ho vyprážaj tesne pred jedlom.
steps.en: Drain the cheese on kitchen paper and serve at once with the potatoes and tartare sauce. It loses its crunch as it cools, so fry it just before eating.

description.sk: Jemne kyslý krémový prívarok z nastrúhanej cukety s kôprom, so zemiakmi a vajcom.
description.en: A gently tangy, creamy stew of grated courgette and dill, with potatoes and egg.

steps.sk: Cukety umy, odkroj konce a nastrúhaj ich na hrubom strúhadle; mladé nemusíš šúpať ani zbavovať jadierok. Posoľ ich ½ lyžičkou soli a nechaj 10 minút odstáť, potom ich v hrsti vytlač, aby pustili prebytočnú vodu.
steps.en: Wash the courgettes, trim the ends and coarsely grate them; young ones need neither peeling nor deseeding. Salt them with ½ teaspoon of salt, leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze them by the handful to press out the excess water.

steps.sk: Medzitým ošúp zemiaky, nakrájaj na štvrtiny a var ich v osolenej vode (½ lyžičky soli) 20 minút do mäkka. Vajcia var 9 minút natvrdo a ponor ich do studenej vody.
steps.en: Meanwhile, peel and quarter the potatoes and boil them in salted water (½ teaspoon of salt) for 20 minutes until tender. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and plunge them into cold water.

steps.sk: Na masle speň nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 4 minúty, posyp ju múkou a mletou paprikou a miešaj minútu, kým múka nezačne voňať. Pridaj cukety, 200 ml vody, ocot, cukor a zvyšnú soľ a var prikryté 10 minút.
steps.en: Soften the finely chopped onion in the butter for 4 minutes, sprinkle over the flour and paprika and stir for a minute until the flour smells toasty. Add the courgettes, 200 ml water, the vinegar, sugar and remaining salt and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Kyslú smotanu rozmiešaj s 3 lyžicami horúcej omáčky, aby sa nezrazila, a vlej ju do hrnca. Pridaj kôpor a za miešania prihrej 2 minúty, ale už nevar. Prívarok má byť hustý, jemne kyslý a sladkastý.
steps.en: Stir 3 spoonfuls of the hot sauce into the sour cream so it does not split, then pour it into the pan. Add the dill and warm through for 2 minutes, stirring, without letting it boil. The stew should be thick, gently sour and slightly sweet.

steps.sk: Podávaj so zemiakmi a ošúpaným vajcom natvrdo prekrojeným na polovice. V chladničke vydrží 2 dni; pri ohrievaní ho len prihrej, var by smotanu zrazil.
steps.en: Serve with the potatoes and a peeled, halved hard-boiled egg. It keeps in the fridge for 2 days; when reheating, only warm it, as boiling splits the cream.

title.sk: Kuracie prsia v hubovej omáčke s ryžou
title.en: Chicken breast in mushroom cream sauce with rice

description.sk: Opečené kuracie rezne v smotanovej omáčke so šampiňónmi a tymianom.
description.en: Seared chicken breast in a creamy mushroom and thyme sauce.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var s 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 15 minút. Kuracie prsia nakrájaj na rezne hrubé 1,5 cm, posoľ ich lyžičkou soli a okoreň.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 15 minutes. Cut the chicken breasts into escalopes 1.5 cm thick and season them with a teaspoon of salt and the pepper.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej na stredne silnom ohni a mäso opekaj 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany, kým nie je zlatisté a vnútri nemá 74 °C – na reze je biele, bez ružovej. Prelož ho na tanier a prikry.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until golden and 74 °C inside, white in the middle with no pink. Transfer to a plate and cover.

steps.sk: Na tú istú panvicu daj maslo, nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a huby nakrájané na plátky. Opekaj 6 až 8 minút, kým sa šťava z húb neodparí a nezačnú hnednúť – mokré huby by omáčku zriedili. Pridaj cesnak a tymian na 30 sekúnd.
steps.en: In the same pan, add the butter, the finely chopped onion and the sliced mushrooms. Fry for 6 to 8 minutes until the mushroom juices evaporate and they start to brown; wet mushrooms would water down the sauce. Add the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.

steps.sk: Huby popráš múkou, premiešaj, prilej 150 ml vody a smotanu a povar 3 minúty, kým omáčka nezhustne. Vráť do nej mäso aj so šťavou, ktorá z neho vytiekla, a 2 minúty ho v nej prehrej.
steps.en: Dust the mushrooms with the flour, stir, pour in 150 ml water and the cream and simmer for 3 minutes until the sauce thickens. Return the chicken with its resting juices and heat it through in the sauce for 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Dochuť zvyšnou soľou, posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou. Do krabičiek rozdeľ mäso s omáčkou a ryžu; v chladničke vydržia 3 dni.
steps.en: Season with the remaining salt, scatter over the parsley and serve with the rice. Portion the chicken, sauce and rice into boxes; they keep in the fridge for 3 days.

title.en: Slovak pierogi filled with potato and bryndza

description.sk: Domáce cestové taštičky so zemiakovo-bryndzovou plnkou, kyslou smotanou a chrumkavou slaninou.
description.en: Homemade dumplings with a potato and sheep's cheese filling, sour cream and crisp bacon.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj a var v osolenej vode (½ lyžičky soli) 20 minút do mäkka. Sceď ich, roztlač na hladkú kašu a nechaj vychladnúť, potom do nich vmiešaj bryndzu. Plnka má byť hustá, inak bude pri tvarovaní vytekať.
steps.en: Peel and chop the potatoes and boil them in salted water (½ teaspoon of salt) for 20 minutes until tender. Drain, mash until smooth and leave to cool, then mix in the bryndza. The filling should be thick, or it oozes out as you shape the pierogi.

steps.sk: K múke pridaj vajce, olej, ½ lyžičky soli a asi 180 ml vlažnej vody a vymies hladké, pružné cesto, ktoré sa nelepí. Zabaľ ho do fólie a nechaj 30 minút odpočívať – potom sa lepšie vaľká a nesťahuje sa.
steps.en: Add the egg, oil, ½ teaspoon of salt and about 180 ml lukewarm water to the flour and knead into a smooth, elastic dough that does not stick. Wrap it and rest it for 30 minutes; it then rolls out easily without shrinking back.

steps.sk: Cesto rozvaľkaj na pomúčenej doske na hrúbku 2 mm a pohárom vykrajuj kruhy s priemerom 8 cm. Na každý daj lyžičku plnky, prelož ho na polmesiac a okraje pevne stlač vidličkou. Hotové pirohy ukladaj na pomúčenú utierku.
steps.en: Roll the dough out on a floured board to 2 mm thick and cut out 8 cm rounds with a glass. Put a teaspoon of filling on each, fold into a half-moon and press the edges firmly with a fork. Lay the finished pierogi on a floured tea towel.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci priveď do varu vodu a pirohy var po dávkach. Keď vyplávajú na povrch, var ich ešte 3 až 4 minúty, potom ich vyber dierovanou lyžicou a premiešaj s maslom, aby sa nezlepili.
steps.en: Bring a large pot of water to the boil and cook the pierogi in batches. Once they float to the surface, cook them for another 3 to 4 minutes, then lift them out with a slotted spoon and toss them in the butter so they do not stick together.

steps.sk: Medzitým opraž na suchej panvici na kocky nakrájanú slaninu 6 minút do chrumkava. Pirohy podávaj s kyslou smotanou, posypané slaninou s výpekom a pažítkou. Nevarené pirohy zamraz na tácke a var ich priamo z mrazničky.
steps.en: Meanwhile, fry the diced bacon in a dry pan for 6 minutes until crisp. Serve the pierogi with sour cream, scattered with the bacon and its fat and the chives. Freeze uncooked pierogi on a tray and cook them straight from frozen.

description.sk: Zemiaky pečené v šupke s rascou a chladivý tvaroh s pažítkou, kôprom a cesnakom.
description.en: Caraway roast potatoes in their skins with cool quark, chives, dill and garlic.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Zemiaky dôkladne umy kefkou, osuš a prekroj pozdĺžne na polovice. Rezné plochy narež do mriežky hlbokej 5 mm, potri ich olejom a posyp lyžičkou soli, rascou a mletou paprikou.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Scrub the potatoes well, dry them and halve them lengthways. Score the cut sides in a 5 mm deep criss-cross, brush with oil and sprinkle with a teaspoon of salt, the caraway and the paprika.

steps.sk: Polož ich reznou plochou nahor na plech s papierom na pečenie a peč 40 až 45 minút, kým nie sú zlatisté a nôž nimi neprejde bez odporu.
steps.en: Lay them cut side up on a lined baking tray and roast for 40 to 45 minutes until golden and a knife passes through without resistance.

steps.sk: Medzitým zmiešaj tvaroh s kyslou smotanou, prelisovaným cesnakom, nasekanou pažítkou a kôprom, zvyšnou soľou a korením na hladký krém; ak je príliš hustý, rozrieď ho lyžicou vody. Reďkovky nakrájaj na tenké plátky.
steps.en: Meanwhile, mix the quark with the sour cream, crushed garlic, chopped chives and dill, the remaining salt and the pepper into a smooth cream; loosen it with a spoonful of water if it is too thick. Slice the radishes thinly.

steps.sk: Horúce zemiaky podávaj s veľkou lyžicou bylinkového tvarohu a reďkovkami. Tvaroh vydrží prikrytý v chladničke 3 dni a upečené zemiaky prehreješ v rúre alebo na panvici.
steps.en: Serve the hot potatoes with a big spoonful of the herby quark and the radishes. The quark keeps covered in the fridge for 3 days, and the roast potatoes reheat in the oven or a frying pan.

title.sk: Granadír – cestoviny so zemiakmi a cibuľkou
title.en: Grenadier march: pasta with potatoes, paprika and onion

description.sk: Lacná klasika z čias, keď sa varilo z toho, čo bolo doma: cestoviny, zemiaky, cibuľa a paprika.
description.en: A frugal classic from the days of cooking with what was at home: pasta, potatoes, onion and paprika.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1,5 cm a var ich v osolenej vode (½ lyžičky soli) 12 minút, kým nezmäknú, ale nerozpadajú sa. Sceď ich.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into 1.5 cm cubes and boil them in salted water (½ teaspoon of salt) for 12 minutes until tender but still holding their shape. Drain.

steps.sk: V inom hrnci uvar cestoviny vo vriacej vode so zvyšnou soľou podľa návodu na obale, zvyčajne 9 až 10 minút, a sceď ich.
steps.en: In another pan, cook the pasta in boiling water with the rest of the salt as the packet directs, usually 9 to 10 minutes, and drain.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej a cibuľu nakrájanú na tenké polkolieska na ňom smaž na strednom ohni 10 minút, kým nie je zlatohnedá a sladká. Stiahni panvicu z ohňa a vmiešaj mletú papriku a rascu – na ohni by paprika zhorkla.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the thinly sliced onions over a medium heat for 10 minutes until golden brown and sweet. Take the pan off the heat and stir in the paprika and caraway; over the flame the paprika would turn bitter.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky a cestoviny, premiešaj, aby sa obalili paprikovým olejom, a opekaj 3 až 4 minúty na strednom ohni, kým sa zemiaky na okrajoch nezačnú zlatiť. Okoreň a ochutnaj.
steps.en: Add the potatoes and pasta, toss to coat them in the paprika oil and fry over a medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the potatoes start to colour at the edges. Season with pepper and taste.

steps.sk: Podávaj s nakrájanými kyslými uhorkami, ktoré k tomuto jedlu patria. Granadír vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; prehreješ ho na panvici s kvapkou oleja.
steps.en: Serve with sliced pickles, which belong with this dish. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days and reheats in a frying pan with a drop of oil.

title.en: Šunkofleky: Czech baked pasta with ham

description.sk: Cestoviny so šunkou a cibuľkou zapečené vo vajíčkach so smotanou, so zlatou syrovou kôrkou.
description.en: Pasta with ham and onion baked in eggs and sour cream under a golden cheese crust.

note.en: pasta squares or other short pasta

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C a zapekaciu misu vymaž trochou masla. Cestoviny uvar vo vode s ½ lyžičkou soli o 2 minúty kratšie, než je na obale – v rúre ešte dôjdu. Sceď ich a prepláchni studenou vodou, aby sa nezlepili.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and grease a baking dish with a little of the butter. Cook the pasta in water with ½ teaspoon of salt for 2 minutes less than the packet says, as it finishes in the oven. Drain and rinse with cold water so it does not stick.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a speň ju na zvyšnom masle 4 minúty do sklovita. Šunku nakrájaj na drobné kocky.
steps.en: Chop the onion finely and soften it in the remaining butter for 4 minutes until translucent. Dice the ham small.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj s kyslou smotanou, mliekom, zvyšnou soľou, korením a muškátovým orieškom. V mise zmiešaj cestoviny so šunkou a cibuľou, prelej ich vaječnou zmesou a uhlaď povrch.
steps.en: Whisk the eggs with the sour cream, milk, remaining salt, pepper and nutmeg. Mix the pasta with the ham and onion in the dish, pour over the egg mixture and level the top.

steps.sk: Posyp ich strúhaným syrom a zapekaj 25 až 30 minút, kým vajcia nestuhnú a povrch nie je zlatistý. Keď do stredu zapichneš nôž, nemá z neho vytekať tekuté vajce.
steps.en: Scatter over the grated cheese and bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the eggs have set and the top is golden. A knife pushed into the centre should come out without any runny egg.

steps.sk: Nechaj ich 5 minút postáť, posyp pažítkou a podávaj s kyslou uhorkou alebo zeleninovým šalátom. Nakrájané na porcie vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a dobre sa prehrievajú v mikrovlnke.
steps.en: Let it stand for 5 minutes, sprinkle with chives and serve with a pickle or a green salad. Cut into portions, it keeps in the fridge for 3 days and reheats well in the microwave.

title.sk: Pstruh na masle s petržlenovými zemiakmi
title.en: Pan-fried trout in brown butter with parsley potatoes

description.sk: Filety s chrumkavou kožou, orieškové maslo s cesnakom a citrónom a mladé zemiaky.
description.en: Crisp-skinned fillets, nutty garlic and lemon butter and parsley potatoes.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na rovnako veľké kusy a var ich v osolenej vode (½ lyžičky soli) 18 až 20 minút do mäkka. Pstruhy opláchni, osuš papierovou utierkou a prejdi po nich prstami, či v nich nezostali kostičky.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into even pieces and boil them in salted water (½ teaspoon of salt) for 18 to 20 minutes until tender. Rinse the trout, pat it dry with kitchen paper and run your fingers over it to check for pin bones.

steps.sk: Filety posoľ zvyšnou soľou zo strany mäsa, okoreň a obaľ v múke; prebytočnú múku oklep. Tenká vrstva múky vytvorí kôrku a koža sa neprilepí na panvicu.
steps.en: Season the flesh side of the fillets with the remaining salt and the pepper and dust them in flour, shaking off the excess. A thin layer of flour forms a crust and stops the skin sticking to the pan.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej s polovicou masla na stredne silnom ohni. Keď maslo prestane peniť, polož pstruhy kožou nadol a peč ich 4 minúty bez posúvania, kým koža nie je chrumkavá. Otoč ich a peč ešte 1 až 2 minúty; hotové sú, keď sa mäso ľahko oddeľuje na lupienky.
steps.en: Heat the oil with half the butter in a frying pan over a medium-high heat. When the butter stops foaming, lay the trout in skin side down and cook for 4 minutes without moving them until the skin is crisp. Turn and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more; they are done when the flesh flakes easily.

steps.sk: Rybu prelož na taniere. Do panvice pridaj zvyšné maslo a nasekaný cesnak a nechaj maslo 1 minútu speniť, kým nezhnedne do orieškova. Vmiešaj lyžicu citrónovej šťavy a polovicu petržlenovej vňate.
steps.en: Move the fish to plates. Add the rest of the butter and the chopped garlic to the pan and let the butter foam for 1 minute until it turns nutty brown. Stir in a tablespoon of lemon juice and half the parsley.

steps.sk: Scedené zemiaky premiešaj so zvyšnou vňaťou a lyžicou masla z panvice. Rybu prelej zvyšným maslom a podávaj so zemiakmi a mesiačikmi citróna. Jedz ju hneď, ohrievaná vysychá.
steps.en: Toss the drained potatoes with the rest of the parsley and a spoonful of butter from the pan. Spoon the remaining butter over the fish and serve with the potatoes and lemon wedges. Eat it straight away, as reheated trout dries out.

title.sk: Kuracia pečeň na cibuľke s ryžou
title.en: Chicken livers with onions and rice

description.sk: Lacné a výživné jedlo: pečeň na sladkej cibuľke s majoránom a paprikou.
description.en: A cheap, nourishing dish of chicken livers on sweet onions with marjoram and paprika.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var s 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 15 minút, potom ju nechaj 5 minút dôjsť. Pečeň opláchni, osuš, odstráň z nej blany a zelenkasté miesta (žlč by ju sfarbila na horko) a nakrájaj na kúsky veľké ako vlašský orech.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 15 minutes, then let it stand for 5. Rinse and dry the livers, trim off membranes and any greenish spots (bile makes them bitter) and cut them into walnut-sized pieces.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a na oleji ju smaž na strednom ohni 10 minút, kým nie je mäkká a zlatá. Pridaj mletú papriku a hneď aj pečeň.
steps.en: Slice the onions thinly and fry them in the oil over a medium heat for 10 minutes until soft and golden. Add the paprika and the livers straight after.

steps.sk: Pečeň popráš múkou a opekaj ju na silnejšom ohni 4 až 5 minút za občasného miešania. Hotová je, keď je na reze svetlohnedá bez krvavej šťavy (70 °C); dlhším pečením stvrdne. Osoľ ju až teraz, skorá soľ ju robí tuhou.
steps.en: Dust the livers with the flour and fry over a fairly high heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring now and then. They are done when light brown inside with no bloody juices (70 °C); longer cooking turns them tough. Salt them only now, as early salt toughens them.

steps.sk: Prilej 100 ml vody, pridaj maslo, majorán a korenie a povar 2 minúty, aby vznikla šťavnatá omáčka. Podávaj s ryžou a kyslou uhorkou; pečeň je najlepšia hneď, v chladničke vydrží najviac 1 deň.
steps.en: Pour in 100 ml water, add the butter, marjoram and pepper and simmer for 2 minutes to make a glossy sauce. Serve with the rice and a pickle; liver is best eaten at once and keeps in the fridge for 1 day at most.

title.sk: Kulajda – krémová zemiaková polievka s kôprom
title.en: Kulajda: creamy potato and dill soup with poached egg

description.sk: Česká polievka zo zemiakov a húb so smotanou, kôprom, octom a strateným vajcom.
description.en: A Czech soup of potatoes and mushrooms with sour cream, dill, vinegar and a poached egg.

steps.sk: Ak máš sušené huby, namoč ich na 20 minút do 200 ml teplej vody. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1 cm, čerstvé huby na plátky. Zemiaky daj do hrnca s 1,2 litra vody, rascou, bobkovým listom, novým korením a soľou a var 12 minút.
steps.en: If using dried mushrooms, soak them in 200 ml warm water for 20 minutes. Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1 cm cubes; slice the fresh mushrooms. Put the potatoes in a pan with 1.2 litres of water, the caraway, bay leaf, allspice and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým opeč čerstvé huby na masle 5 minút, kým nezmäknú a nezačnú voňať, a pridaj ich k zemiakom spolu s namočenými hubami aj ich vodou.
steps.en: Meanwhile, fry the fresh mushrooms in the butter for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant, then add them to the potatoes along with any soaked mushrooms and their water.

steps.sk: Kyslú smotanu rozšľahaj s múkou dohladka, primiešaj k nej naberačku horúcej polievky a až potom ju vlej do hrnca – takto sa nezrazí. Za stáleho miešania var 5 minút, kým polievka nezhustne.
steps.en: Whisk the sour cream with the flour until smooth, stir in a ladle of the hot soup and only then pour it into the pan, so it does not split. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring all the time, until the soup thickens.

steps.sk: Polievku dochuť 2 lyžicami octu, aby bola príjemne kyslá, vmiešaj kôpor a okoreň. Nechaj ju na najmenšom ohni, aby už nevrela.
steps.en: Sharpen the soup with 2 tablespoons of vinegar until pleasantly sour, stir in the dill and season with pepper. Keep it on the lowest heat so it no longer boils.

steps.sk: V malom hrnci priveď vodu so zvyšným octom do mierneho varu, lyžicou vytvor vír a vajcia doň po jednom opatrne vklzni. Var ich 3 minúty, kým bielok stuhne a žĺtok zostane tekutý, a vyber ich dierovanou lyžicou.
steps.en: Bring a small pan of water with the rest of the vinegar to a gentle simmer, stir it into a whirlpool and slide the eggs in one at a time. Poach them for 3 minutes until the whites set and the yolks stay runny, then lift them out with a slotted spoon.

steps.sk: Polievku rozlej do tanierov a do každého polož stratené vajce. Podávaj s chlebom; bez vajec vydrží v chladničke 2 dni a len ju prihrej, prudký var by smotanu zrazil.
steps.en: Ladle the soup into bowls and top each with a poached egg. Serve with bread; without the eggs it keeps in the fridge for 2 days, and should only be warmed through, as a hard boil splits the cream.

description.sk: Vegánsky guláš z opečeného sójového granulátu s paprikou, rascou a majoránom.
description.en: A vegan goulash of browned soy mince with paprika, caraway and marjoram.

steps.sk: Sójový granulát zalej 1 litrom vriacej vody s rozdrobeným bujónom a nechaj ho 10 minút napučať. Potom ho sceď a rukami poriadne vytlač – čím je sušší, tým lepšie vsaje chuť guláša.
steps.en: Pour 1 litre of boiling water with the crumbled stock cube over the soy mince and leave it to swell for 10 minutes. Drain it and squeeze it hard with your hands; the drier it is, the more flavour it soaks up.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var s 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 15 minút. Medzitým nakrájaj cibuľu nadrobno a papriku na kocky.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, chop the onions finely and dice the pepper.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej olej, cibuľu na ňom smaž 8 minút do zlatista, potom pridaj granulát a opekaj ho za miešania 5 minút, kým sa nezačne prichytávať a hnednúť – vtedy získa mäsitú chuť.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the onions for 8 minutes until golden, then add the soy mince and fry, stirring, for 5 minutes until it starts to catch and brown; that is where its meaty flavour comes from.

steps.sk: Stiahni hrniec z ohňa, vmiešaj mletú papriku, paradajkový pretlak a múku a hneď zalej 600 ml vody. Pridaj nakrájanú papriku, rascu, sójovú omáčku a soľ a var prikryté 15 minút na miernom ohni.
steps.en: Take the pot off the heat, stir in the paprika, tomato paste and flour and immediately pour in 600 ml water. Add the diced pepper, caraway, soy sauce and salt and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Nakoniec pridaj prelisovaný cesnak a majorán, okoreň a povar ešte 2 minúty. Guláš má byť hustý; ak je riedky, var ho chvíľu bez pokrievky.
steps.en: Finally, add the crushed garlic and marjoram, season with pepper and simmer for 2 more minutes. The goulash should be thick; if it is runny, cook it uncovered for a little longer.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou alebo chlebom. Guláš vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť, takže sa oplatí uvariť dvojitú dávku.
steps.en: Serve with the rice or with bread. The goulash keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well, so it is worth making a double batch.
